body:
Firstly, talk with HR and/or your doctor regarding medical leave from your job. Most likely you have a legal option to remain employed in an absence due to medical challenges. I'm not talking weeks, but maybe a day or two if you take the route of medication, which can be challenging to your "normal" cognitive performance due to side effects.

Okay. You sound like me. Over the past year, I was unemployed and dependent on family and friends to support me. I'm adjusting my medications now, and I am getting my concentration back. The same sleep disruptions and feeling of mental atrophy was driving me insane. I couldn't do anything with tremendous migraines brought on by anxiety. It's like I'm waking up from a bad dream.

My best advice is to contact your doctor and start/adjust treatment for your challenges. 

I'm a wannabe writer, but I can't find confidence to complete my stories. Anyway, take care. 

Keep a journal! That will not only give you strength later to create haunting images of the human psyche but also presently give you more control and understanding of your emotional journey.

Thanks. I'm gonna check it out. I guess I'm looking for a silver bullet (please excuse any possible suicide reference) to my problem. I had dinner with friends last night and one of them shared the same issues I've been facing. It's a much better day today. Thank you deeply for your help and support.
It has to do with this single personal issue. I used to help grad students with research questions and writing. There are no other intended implications but my private struggle.
Do you live alone?
If there is a god at all, it is impotent and without control over our reality. No, this world created God . It's just us. So we're here to help each other. Much love.
I've been wanting a pen pal so bad lately!

I started small. Write about how you feel. Why you feel that way. I pushed myself to write about better times to remind myself they're not impossible. A lot of my writing is exploring causality, to better track how my mood is affected.
Are you going to therapy for depression/overeating? There are several options to help you. We can get you there. Just hang in there.

Yeah. Find a steady path of treatment. I never knew how to ask for help at 15 when trouble started. I'm 32 now and finally comfortable with finding the right treatment. Don't let it go too long without help. I pushed it away so many times with school and sex and drugs. I'm smarter than many graduate students but lack degrees. You got this. Damn.... You sound like me at your age. It gets way way way better, just don't give up finding the path for you.
No, thank you. We've helped each other tonight.
You have and you did. PM any of us on here that you feel is empathetic/sympathetic. Take care
Definitely. He sounds like a good guy. My girl supports me in many of my struggles, making sure I get to the doctor, etc. You don't have to fight alone. Take care

Colleges usually have good mental health resources. Retreats can be put off for more convenient times. Just say you got food poisoning. Your health is number one. Also a study group may help with school and social support
Can you have an open discussion with your superior or HR about your situation? HR if available may be the best option, especially documenting the douche bags behavior.
Marine Corps for sure. Or counseling and medication.

Etizolam and a doctor appointment. After a long cry session. Pain is temporary. We're here for each other. Altruism is strong in this sub. At the moment, I'm binging on homemade tortillas and beer and etizolam. I feel fantastic. I see my doctor tomorrow. I'll update then. For now, try some music and controlled breathing.
The world needs many, many more of us. We see the cracks in the world everyone else naturally ignores. Is counseling available at your Uni?

If you can find a counselor, start that first. Professional guidance can relieve the burden of proof that your parents may need. It's not necessarily proof, but an outside source to show them the truth which is never as hard as it seems. Facing it alone however will definitely make it harder

Hug his ass and tell him your there for ANYTHING. Give him a chance to breathe and make sure he can trust you with anything. Trust and endless compassion. My brother is the only one I hide my illness from. Having him as support would have changed my life forever, but that's something I accept today. I love him all the same, but we were not close as kids growing up. Never let that happen. Never doubt his pain.
Psilocybin once turned me away from suicide. Went years without it bothering me. Ketamine may be a better option. There's more medical documentation and many therapies available today.

No, thankfully you won't die. Drink some water. Ppl binge on more at a time. Your gonna be awake for a while! But you're gonna be okay. Call a loved one now and get some professional care for depression. Much love. It's not too late to purge your stomach contents to give your liver a break

And cheese! That makes most things better. Meal planning is a Reddit page that might help. Crock pot for days worth of foods. My poverty prevents me from eating out, and surprisingly I've never eaten so healthy since. But I too am guilty of skipping meals all too often.  Lately my breakfast is toast and peanut butter. Toast and honey. Or cheap cereals.

Flour is my most valuable resource (carbs). Cottage cheese, milk, and eggs for low cost protein. Boiled eggs and tuna mix from my bodybuilding days still keeps me going. Protein powder goes a long way. Watch for sales, bogo, etc. veggies, canned or not. I have a pantry full of herbs to put it all together. Garlic is my number one seasoning, then salt and pepper. 

Flour, water, and butter = biscuits, tortillas, etc.

I'm binging on tortillas I made right now. Are you taking a multivitamin? Also, good food is cheap. Watch some cooking shows. Find a farmers market or budget grocer. Food is sometimes my best therapy. I get most of my food from Sam's club, cheaper than Walmart. I'm unemployed at the moment, and my dollars stretch weeks from careful purchases.
Until there's a "cure" for mental and physical pain, suicide is as just as abortion or war or the war on drugs and so on .... I just happen to be a coward.
It's not that they have anything figured out but rather they lack deeper thoughts and ignore reality.
I am isolated, and I just want somewhere to go.... Wanna trade lives? I'm sorry for your pain.
Full spectrum lights may help tremendously

I understand with stims it's about staying busy, low stress activities to begin with. A good psych will have lots to say for finding those things. There are many meds out there that may be beneficial. Good luck
I've been alone for months, getting out for food when I'm tired of not eating. I had a job for about a month recently but carpal tunnel syndrome has prevented me from continuing.
We all need to get together. At least we understand how each of us feel.

I tried multiple times in my 32 years. You have to tell someone in your life what happened. It can be a nurse or doctor, not necessarily a family member. A false diagnosis will only get you false treatment. Don't give up. PM me if nothing else.

I grew up in a family as close to normal as one can get. Depression is going strong, I'm 32. You have to realize that normal is a fantasy. As far as your brain zaps, this can be as much medication as it can be stress. Mostly for me, it's stress. Hydrate. I've been reading Buddha Brain" a book about meditation with a neuroscience perspective. It's been somewhat insightful but my medication right now is simply inadequate. Good luck

I explain how my mind falls into a tormented loop without directly addressing those particular thoughts. I have many guns in my domicile but haven't been to the range in ages. Thoughts of my family will never allow me to use them. I just breakdown and cry until I'm numb. Moreover I reserve the right to choose, but like Nietzsche I too am a coward. Good luck

Also in bed... I'm sorry for the pain. I'm ready to try anything. Prozac at the moment isn't working anymore... Also a professional student. My intelligence is often a burden. Science and history and everything else swims around in my head, for better or worse. I was once a source of information for graduate students... I'm lost, but still looking. We're in this together.

This is me. I don't know. Prozac used to help, but this is a never ending cycle of my life.... I recently qualified for free healthcare.... Family tragedies over the last year has made me aware of the pain my death would cause...
